name: DCP — Largest arrears by customer
description: Current arrears summed per customer over open collection cases, largest first, bounded to the top 25. Grain: CUSTOMER (one row per customer lookup). Source: qdb_collectioncase · qdb_currenttotalarrears grouped by qdb_customerid. Narrowed by source system (HL/BFD) and bucket when supplied. DCP catalogue DCP-RPT-006.
fetchXml: <fetch aggregate="true" top="25"><entity name="qdb_collectioncase"><attribute name="qdb_customerid" groupby="true" alias="customer"/><attribute name="qdb_currenttotalarrears" aggregate="sum" alias="arrears"/><attribute name="qdb_collectioncaseid" aggregate="count" alias="cases"/><order alias="arrears" descending="true"/><filter><condition attribute="statecode" operator="eq" value="0"/></filter></entity></fetch>
